#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Read stdin, lower-case, split on non-letter chars, print top-3 words by frequency.
# Ties broken alphabetically. Output: "<word> <count>" per line.
tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' |
  grep -o '[a-z]\+' |
  sort |
  uniq -c |
  sort -k1,1rn -k2,2 |
  head -n 3 |
  awk '{print $2, $1}'
